name: Arva SEO (formerly Bulk Meta Editor)
author: Aries Dajay

sections.description:
Formerly Bulk Meta Editor by Aries Dajay / Dajay Digital

UPDATED! New version plugin

Your Ultimate SEO Assistant. Created for SEO Specialist who do site audits and
assist them with the process making SEO fixes more fun and easy! Bulk updates the metadata such as the title, description, canonical url, and the indexing of a page. Created for most Web Developers and SEO Specialists who do website audits.

UPGRADE TO PRO for more features!

Features:

  • Bulk SEO Meta Title Update
  • Bulk SEO Meta Description Update
  • Bulk Canonical URL Update
  • Bulk Noindex/Nofollow Update for pages and posts
  • Supports Yoast SEO out of the box
  • Support other SEO plugins like RankMath, SEOPress, All-in-One SEO (PRO)
  • Crawl the site and check for issues (PRO)
  • See opportunities to improve SEO (PRO)
  • Support Bulk Editing of WooCommerce Products (PRO)
sections.installation:
1. Upload arva-seo.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Enter your license key or use free license
  4. Enjoy!
sections.faq:
Do you offer support?

Yes, please send us an email directly at the Contact Us screen.
